arStrings.szText: {c_important}Barrage{/c} deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_A_IMPACT}{/c} damage and fires {c_number}[SF_25]{/c} additional arrows and all of its arrows now travel faster and pierce through {c_number}[SF_51]{/c} additional enemies.

{c_important}Barrage{/c} no longer pierces and fires {c_number}{SF_45}{/c} less arrows. Its arrows each drop {c_number}{SF_27}{/c} {c_important}{u}Stun Grenade{/u}{/c} that deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_B_STUN_GRENADE_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage.

{c_important}Barrage{/c} fires arrows into the air, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_C_IMPACT}{/c} damage upon landing. Each arrow causes the enemy it hits to take {c_number}[{SF_48}*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage from {c_important}Barrage{/c} for the next {c_number}{SF_49}{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}[{SF_48} * {SF_50} * 100|%x|]{/c}. Barrage now also creates an {c_important}{u}Arrow Storm{/u}{/c}, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_C_DAMAGE_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage.
{c_important}Barrage{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_47}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage against {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} or {c_important}{u}Weakened{/u}{/c} enemies.

Casting {c_important}Barrage{/c} consumes {c_number}{SF_59}{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c} to fire {c_number}{SF_58}{/c} additional arrows and all arrows to deal {c_number}[{SF_57}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage.
